narrative: The technology sector is marked by user-centric challenges as Google faces criticism for its new Fitbit integration, while American Airlines boosts connectivity with a major Starlink contract. The AI industry continues its rapid evolution, with OpenRouter's significant valuation jump and collaborative efforts between Universal Music Group and TikTok to regulate AI-generated music. Concurrently, new advancements in robotics and organizational hurdles in adopting agentic AI are shaping the future of innovation, alongside critical concerns regarding data security, highlighted by a recent 7-Eleven breach.

highlights.title: Google Health is here, but a lot of people want their Fitbit app back instead
highlights.whyItMatters: Google's new health platform, replacing the popular Fitbit app, is facing user backlash and confusion.

highlights.title: SpaceX’s Starlink nabs American Airlines contract, another win for its IPO
highlights.whyItMatters: American Airlines will install Starlink Wi-Fi on over 500 aircraft, marking a significant expansion for SpaceX's satellite internet service.

highlights.title: OpenRouter more than doubles valuation to $1.3B in a year
highlights.whyItMatters: OpenRouter's rapid valuation increase demonstrates strong market confidence in multi-AI-model platforms and their future growth.

highlights.title: 3D-printable humanoid legs let robotics experiments run wild
highlights.whyItMatters: Hugging Face's accessible $2,500 bipedal robot project is set to accelerate research and development in robotics.

highlights.title: Universal Music Group and TikTok renew agreement to combat unauthorized AI music
highlights.whyItMatters: This renewed partnership aims to establish stricter content moderation policies against AI-generated music, addressing intellectual property concerns.

highlights.title: Rethinking organizational design in the age of agentic AI
highlights.whyItMatters: A new report highlights that despite high ambitions for agentic AI adoption, most organizations lack the operational readiness to implement it effectively.

highlights.title: 7-Eleven data breach affects over 185,000 people’s personal data
highlights.whyItMatters: A significant data breach at 7-Eleven exposed personal data of over 185,000 individuals, raising concerns about consumer data security.
